verses.greek: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦν ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.
verses.literal: After these things there was feast of the Jews and went up Jesus to Jerusalem.
verses.dgt: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.greek: ἔστιν δὲ ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐπὶ τῇ προβατικῇ κολυμβήθρα ἡ ἐπιλεγομένη Ἑβραϊστὶ Βηθεσδά, πέντε στοὰς ἔχουσα·
verses.literal: There is now in the Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool which is being called in Hebrew Bethzatha five porches having.
verses.dgt: Now in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate there is a pool, called in Hebrew Bethzatha, which has five covered colonnades.
notes: SBLGNT and TAGNT have different place-name spellings here; the displayed Greek follows SBLGNT.

verses.greek: ἐν ταύταις κατέκειτο πλῆθος τῶν ἀσθενούντων, τυφλῶν, χωλῶν, ξηρῶν.
verses.literal: In these were lying a multitude of those ailing blind lame paralyzed
verses.dgt: In these lay a great number of the sick—the blind, lame, and paralyzed.

verses.greek: ἦν δέ τις ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖ τριάκοντα ὀκτὼ ἔτη ἔχων ἐν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: There was now a certain man there thirty eight years being in the infirmity himself.
verses.dgt: There was a certain man there who had been in his infirmity for thirty-eight years.

verses.greek: τοῦτον ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς κατακείμενον, καὶ γνοὺς ὅτι πολὺν ἤδη χρόνον ἔχει, λέγει αὐτῷ· Θέλεις ὑγιὴς γενέσθαι;
verses.literal: Him having seen the Jesus lying and having known that a long already time he has been He says to him Desire you well to become?
verses.dgt: When Jesus saw him lying there and knew that he had already been in that condition a long time, he said to him, “Do you want to become well?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ ἀσθενῶν· Κύριε, ἄνθρωπον οὐκ ἔχω ἵνα ὅταν ταραχθῇ τὸ ὕδωρ βάλῃ με εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν· ἐν ᾧ δὲ ἔρχομαι ἐγὼ ἄλλος πρὸ ἐμοῦ καταβαίνει.
verses.literal: Answered Him the one ailing Sir a man not I have that when may be stirred the water he may put me into the pool in which now am going I myself another before me descends.
verses.dgt: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am going, another goes down before me.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἔγειρε ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.
verses.literal: Says to him the Jesus do arise do take up the mat of you and do walk.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”

verses.greek: καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο ὑγιὴς ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἦρε τὸν κράβαττον αὐτοῦ καὶ περιεπάτει. Ἦν δὲ σάββατον ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ.
verses.literal: And immediately became well the man and he took up the mat of him and was walking It was now Sabbath on that very the day.
verses.dgt: Immediately the man became well, picked up his mat, and began walking. Now that day was a Sabbath.

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τῷ τεθεραπευμένῳ· Σάββατόν ἐστιν, καὶ οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἆραι τὸν κράβαττον.
verses.literal: Were saying therefore the Jews to the one healed Sabbath it is and not it is lawful for you to take up the mat
verses.dgt: So the Jews were saying to the man who had been healed, “It is the Sabbath, and it is not lawful for you to carry your mat.”

verses.greek: ὃς δὲ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς· Ὁ ποιήσας με ὑγιῆ ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν Ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.
verses.literal: The man however answered them The One having made me well that One to me said do take up the mat of you and do walk.
verses.dgt: But he answered them, “The one who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”

verses.greek: ἠρώτησαν οὖν αὐτόν· Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ εἰπών σοι· Ἆρον καὶ περιπάτει;
verses.literal: They asked therefore him Who is the man the having said to you do take up and do walk?’
verses.dgt: They asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Pick it up and walk’?”

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ ἰαθεὶς οὐκ ᾔδει τίς ἐστιν, ὁ γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐξένευσεν ὄχλου ὄντος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ.
verses.literal: The one now having been healed not knew who it is the for Jesus moved away a crowd being in the place.
verses.dgt: But the man who had been healed did not know who it was, because Jesus had slipped away, since there was a crowd in that place.

verses.greek: μετὰ ταῦτα εὑρίσκει αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἴδε ὑγιὴς γέγονας· μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε, ἵνα μὴ χεῖρόν σοί τι γένηται.
verses.literal: After these things finds him the Jesus in the temple and said to him Behold well you have become no more do sin that not worse to you something may happen.
verses.dgt: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Look, you have become well. Sin no more, so that something worse does not happen to you.”

verses.greek: ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὸν ὑγιῆ.
verses.literal: Went away the man and told to the Jews that Jesus it is the One having made him well.
verses.dgt: The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

verses.greek: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἐδίωκον οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὅτι ταῦτα ἐποίει ἐν σαββάτῳ.
verses.literal: And because of this were persecuting the Jews the Jesus because these things He was doing on the Sabbath.
verses.dgt: Because of this the Jews were persecuting Jesus, because he was doing these things on the Sabbath.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτοῖς· Ὁ πατήρ μου ἕως ἄρτι ἐργάζεται κἀγὼ ἐργάζομαι.
verses.literal: the But answered them The Father of Mine until now is working and I myself am working.
verses.dgt: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is working until now, and I too am working.”

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτο οὖν μᾶλλον ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι ὅτι οὐ μόνον ἔλυε τὸ σάββατον, ἀλλὰ καὶ πατέρα ἴδιον ἔλεγε τὸν θεόν, ἴσον ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: Because of this therefore the more were seeking Him the Jews to kill because not only was He breaking the Sabbath but also Father His own He was naming the God equal Himself making the to God.
verses.dgt: Because of this the Jews were seeking all the more to kill him, because he was not only breaking the Sabbath but was also calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

verses.greek: Ἀπεκρίνατο οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ δύναται ὁ υἱὸς ποιεῖν ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ οὐδὲν ἐὰν μή τι βλέπῃ τὸν πατέρα ποιοῦντα· ἃ γὰρ ἂν ἐκεῖνος ποιῇ, ταῦτα καὶ ὁ υἱὸς ὁμοίως ποιεῖ.
verses.literal: Answered therefore the Jesus and was saying to them Amen Amen I say to you not is able the Son to do of Himself no thing only unless anything He shall see the Father doing. whatever for maybe He shall do these things also the Son likewise does.
verses.dgt: So Jesus answered and said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you: the Son can do nothing from himself unless it is something he sees the Father doing. For whatever the Father does, these things the Son also does in the same way.

verses.greek: ὁ γὰρ πατὴρ φιλεῖ τὸν υἱὸν καὶ πάντα δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ ἃ αὐτὸς ποιεῖ, καὶ μείζονα τούτων δείξει αὐτῷ ἔργα, ἵνα ὑμεῖς θαυμάζητε.
verses.literal: the For the Father loves the Son and all things shows to Him that He himself does and greater than these He will show to Him works so that you yourselves may marvel.
verses.dgt: For the Father loves the Son and shows him everything that he himself does, and he will show him greater works than these, so that you may marvel.

verses.greek: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἐγείρει τοὺς νεκροὺς καὶ ζῳοποιεῖ, οὕτως καὶ ὁ υἱὸς οὓς θέλει ζῳοποιεῖ.
verses.literal: Even as for the Father raises up the dead and gives life thus also the Son to whom He wishes gives life.
verses.dgt: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whomever he wishes.

verses.greek: οὐδὲ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ κρίνει οὐδένα, ἀλλὰ τὴν κρίσιν πᾶσαν δέδωκεν τῷ υἱῷ,
verses.literal: Not for the Father does judge no one but the judgment all has given to the Son
verses.dgt: For the Father judges no one, but has given all judgment to the Son,

verses.greek: ἵνα πάντες τιμῶσι τὸν υἱὸν καθὼς τιμῶσι τὸν πατέρα. ὁ μὴ τιμῶν τὸν υἱὸν οὐ τιμᾷ τὸν πατέρα τὸν πέμψαντα αὐτόν.
verses.literal: so that all may honor the Son even as they honor the Father. He who not is honoring the Son not is honoring the Father the One having sent Him.
verses.dgt: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. The one who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him.

verses.greek: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ τὸν λόγον μου ἀκούων καὶ πιστεύων τῷ πέμψαντί με ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ εἰς κρίσιν οὐκ ἔρχεται ἀλλὰ μεταβέβηκεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you that the one the word of Mine hearing and believing in the One having sent Me he has life eternal and into judgment not comes but has passed out of the death into the life.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: the one who hears my word and believes the one who sent me has eternal life and does not come into judgment, but has passed from death into life.

verses.greek: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν ὅτε οἱ νεκροὶ ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀκούσαντες ζήσουσιν.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you that is coming an hour and now is when the dead will hear the voice of the Son the of God and those having heard will live.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: an hour is coming, and now is here, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.

verses.greek: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἔχει ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, οὕτως καὶ τῷ υἱῷ ἔδωκεν ζωὴν ἔχειν ἐν ἑαυτῷ·
verses.literal: As for the Father has life in Himself so also to the Son He gave life to have in Himself
verses.dgt: For just as the Father has life in himself, so he also gave the Son to have life in himself.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κρίσιν ποιεῖν, ὅτι υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ἐστίν.
verses.literal: And authority He gave to Him judgment to carry out because Son of Man He is.
verses.dgt: And he gave him authority to carry out judgment, because he is Son of Man.

verses.greek: μὴ θαυμάζετε τοῦτο, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ἐν ᾗ πάντες οἱ ἐν τοῖς μνημείοις ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ
verses.literal: Not do marvel at this for is coming an hour in which all those in the tombs will hear the voice of Him
verses.dgt: Do not marvel at this, because an hour is coming when all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

verses.greek: καὶ ἐκπορεύσονται οἱ τὰ ἀγαθὰ ποιήσαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν ζωῆς, οἱ δὲ τὰ φαῦλα πράξαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν κρίσεως.
verses.literal: and will come forth — those the good having done to the resurrection of life the and those evil having done to the resurrection of judgment.
verses.dgt: and will come out—those who have done good to a resurrection of life, and those who have practiced evil to a resurrection of judgment.

verses.greek: Οὐ δύναμαι ἐγὼ ποιεῖν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐδέν· καθὼς ἀκούω κρίνω, καὶ ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ δικαία ἐστίν, ὅτι οὐ ζητῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με.
verses.literal: Not am able I myself to do of Myself no thing even as I hear I judge and the judgment the of Mine just is because not I seek the will the of Me but the will of the One who having sent Me
verses.dgt: I can do nothing from myself. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is just, because I do not seek my own will but the will of the one who sent me.

verses.greek: Ἐὰν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἡ μαρτυρία μου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής·
verses.literal: If I myself shall bear witness concerning Myself the testimony of Mine not is true
verses.dgt: If I testify about myself, my testimony is not valid.

verses.greek: ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία ἣν μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ.
verses.literal: Another it is who is bearing witness concerning Me and I know that true is the testimony which he bears witness concerning Me.
verses.dgt: There is another who testifies about me, and I know that the testimony he gives about me is true.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς ἀπεστάλκατε πρὸς Ἰωάννην, καὶ μεμαρτύρηκε τῇ ἀληθείᾳ·
verses.literal: You yourselves have sent unto John and he has borne witness to the truth
verses.dgt: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου τὴν μαρτυρίαν λαμβάνω, ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λέγω ἵνα ὑμεῖς σωθῆτε.
verses.literal: I myself now not from man the testimony receive but these things I say that you yourselves may be saved.
verses.dgt: Yet I do not receive testimony from a man; I say these things so that you may be saved.

verses.greek: ἐκεῖνος ἦν ὁ λύχνος ὁ καιόμενος καὶ φαίνων, ὑμεῖς δὲ ἠθελήσατε ἀγαλλιαθῆναι πρὸς ὥραν ἐν τῷ φωτὶ αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: He was the lamp which is burning and shining you yourselves now were willing to rejoice for a season in the light of him.
verses.dgt: He was the lamp burning and shining, and you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ δὲ ἔχω τὴν μαρτυρίαν μείζω τοῦ Ἰωάννου, τὰ γὰρ ἔργα ἃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ πατὴρ ἵνα τελειώσω αὐτά, αὐτὰ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιῶ, μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι ὁ πατήρ με ἀπέσταλκεν,
verses.literal: I myself however have the testimony greater than that of John the For the works that has given Me the Father that I may complete them same the works which I do bear witness concerning Me that the Father Me has sent.
verses.dgt: But I have testimony greater than John’s: the works that the Father has given me to complete—the very works I am doing—testify about me that the Father has sent me.

verses.greek: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με πατὴρ ἐκεῖνος μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ ἐμοῦ. οὔτε φωνὴν αὐτοῦ πώποτε ἀκηκόατε οὔτε εἶδος αὐτοῦ ἑωράκατε,
verses.literal: And the One having sent Me the Father Himself has borne witness concerning Me Neither voice of Him at any time have You heard nor form of Him have you seen
verses.dgt: And the Father who sent me has himself testified about me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,

verses.greek: καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ὑμῖν μένοντα, ὅτι ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος τούτῳ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε.
verses.literal: And the word of Him not you have in you abiding for whom sent He in Him you yourselves not believe.
verses.dgt: and you do not have his word remaining in you, because you do not believe the one whom he sent.

verses.greek: Ἐραυνᾶτε τὰς γραφάς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς δοκεῖτε ἐν αὐταῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔχειν· καὶ ἐκεῖναί εἰσιν αἱ μαρτυροῦσαι περὶ ἐμοῦ·
verses.literal: You diligently search the Scriptures for you yourselves think in them life eternal to have and these are they those bearing witness concerning Me
verses.dgt: You search the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life, and these are the very writings that testify about me,

verses.greek: καὶ οὐ θέλετε ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχητε.
verses.literal: and not you are willing to come to Me that life you may have.
verses.dgt: yet you are unwilling to come to me so that you may have life.

verses.greek: δόξαν παρὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ λαμβάνω,
verses.literal: Glory from men not I take
verses.dgt: I do not receive glory from people,

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ἔγνωκα ὑμᾶς ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.
verses.literal: but I have known you that the love the of God not you have in yourselves.
verses.dgt: but I know you: you do not have the love of God in yourselves.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ ἐλήλυθα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετέ με· ἐὰν ἄλλος ἔλθῃ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἰδίῳ, ἐκεῖνον λήμψεσθε.
verses.literal: I myself have come in the name of the Father of Mine and not you receive Me if another shall come in the name the own him you will receive.
verses.dgt: I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

verses.greek: πῶς δύνασθε ὑμεῖς πιστεῦσαι, δόξαν παρʼ ἀλλήλων λαμβάνοντες, καὶ τὴν δόξαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ μόνου θεοῦ οὐ ζητεῖτε;
verses.literal: How are able you yourselves to believe glory from one another receiving and the glory that is from the only God not you seek?
verses.dgt: How can you believe when you receive glory from one another and do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?

verses.greek: μὴ δοκεῖτε ὅτι ἐγὼ κατηγορήσω ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα· ἔστιν ὁ κατηγορῶν ὑμῶν Μωϋσῆς, εἰς ὃν ὑμεῖς ἠλπίκατε.
verses.literal: Not do think that I myself will accuse you to the Father There is one accusing you Moses in whom you yourselves have hoped.
verses.dgt: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. The one accusing you is Moses, in whom you have placed your hope.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ ἐπιστεύετε Μωϋσεῖ, ἐπιστεύετε ἂν ἐμοί, περὶ γὰρ ἐμοῦ ἐκεῖνος ἔγραψεν.
verses.literal: If for you were believing in Moses you were believing then would in Me myself concerning for Me he wrote.
verses.dgt: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me, because he wrote about me.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ τοῖς ἐκείνου γράμμασιν οὐ πιστεύετε, πῶς τοῖς ἐμοῖς ῥήμασιν πιστεύσετε;
verses.literal: If now the in his writings not you believe how the in My declarations will you believe?
verses.dgt: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
